input.content: You are an independent PLC verification engineer. Return ONLY a JSON list of test cases.

You are an independent PLC test engineer. Generate comprehensive unit test cases for the specified PLC function block.
CODESYS Simulation Timing & Edge Rules:
- dt_ms advances elapsed PLC scan time for that step; TON/TOF timers accumulate dt_ms across consecutive steps while IN keeps its active state (e.g., IN=TRUE for TON).
- Rising-edge detection (R_TRIG or x AND NOT prev_x) requires a step with x=FALSE before the step with x=TRUE.

Return a JSON array of test case objects. Each test case must have:
- id: string identifier (e.g. 'case_1')
- steps: array of steps, where each step has:
    - inputs: dictionary of input variable names and values
    - expected: dictionary of expected output variable names and values
    - dt_ms: (optional) cycle elapsed time in milliseconds

TASK SPECIFICATIONS:
{
  "id": "PUB005",
  "title": "Weld Gap Alarm and Startup Inhibition",
  "difficulty": "easy",
  "requirements": "# Weld Gap Alarm and Startup Inhibition\n\n- **Difficulty:** Easy (easy)\n\n## Requirements\n\nControl a weld-gap alarm with power-up monitoring inhibition, input debouncing during normal monitoring and emergency-stop priority.\n\n1. Gap_Exceeded indicates that the scanner has detected a weld gap exceeding the permitted 1.5 mm value.\n2. Begin with a 5-second initialization inhibition period after power-up. During this period, Operator_Alert is FALSE, Weld_Soft_Start_Active is TRUE, and gap-signal debounce time does not accumulate.\n3. Resume gap monitoring after initialization. Allow the alarm only after Gap_Exceeded has remained TRUE for DebounceTime. When the signal becomes FALSE, switch off the alarm and clear debounce timing.\n4. When Weld_E_Stop_NC is FALSE, the emergency stop takes priority over initialization and normal monitoring. Operator_Alert must immediately become FALSE and any incomplete debounce timing must be cleared.\n5. Weld_Soft_Start_Active indicates only the power-up inhibition period; it does not represent a continuous speed ramp.\n\n## Interface Definition\n\n| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Input | `Gap_Exceeded` | `BOOL` | Scanner indication that the gap exceeds 1.5 mm. |\n| Input | `Weld_E_Stop_NC` | `BOOL` | TRUE means the emergency stop is inactive; FALSE means it is active. |\n| Input | `DebounceTime` | `TIME` | Gap-signal debounce duration during normal monitoring; must be positive. |\n| Output | `Operator_Alert` | `BOOL` | Audible and visual alarm command. |\n| Output | `Weld_Soft_Start_Active` | `BOOL` | Monitoring-inhibition status during the 5-second power-up initialization. |",
  "scenario": "Control a weld-gap alarm with power-up monitoring inhibition, input debouncing during normal monitoring and emergency-stop priority.",
  "interface": [
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Gap_Exceeded",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Scanner indication that the gap exceeds 1.5 mm."
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Weld_E_Stop_NC",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "TRUE means the emergency stop is inactive; FALSE means it is active."
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "DebounceTime",
      "type": "TIME",
      "description": "Gap-signal debounce duration during normal monitoring; must be positive."
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Operator_Alert",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Audible and visual alarm command."
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Weld_Soft_Start_Active",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Monitoring-inhibition status during the 5-second power-up initialization."
    }
  ],
  "initial_conditions": {
    "Operator_Alert": false,
    "Weld_Soft_Start_Active": true,
    "startupElapsed_ms": 0,
    "gapElapsed_ms": 0
  },
  "scan_semantics": "At scan k, inputs I[k] are sampled once, q[k] is pre-scan retained state, outputs O[k] are observed after execution, and q[k+1] is the updated state. Each test creates a fresh FB instance before step 0. An initialized instance has not yet executed a scan. Timer elapsed time is zero on the first eligible sampled invocation; dt_ms is elapsed wall time since the previous invocation, not automatically a synthetic input to the FB. No unobserved past input stability is assumed. All sequences here are expected values.",
  "safety_priority": [
    "E-stop immediately suppresses the alarm in every phase.",
    "Initialization suppresses alarm and prevents gap timing."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "Power-up inhibition uses a monotonically advancing 5-second timer that starts on the first FB invocation and continues through E-stop.",
    "Weld_Soft_Start_Active reports startup inhibition even during E-stop. E-stop overrides the alert and resets gap timing but does not restart power-up inhibition.",
    "At exactly 5 seconds startup inhibition clears. That scan is the first eligible gap sample, with gap elapsed zero; there is no credited debounce time during inhibition.",
    "DebounceTime is positive. Alert clears and debounce resets immediately on raw gap FALSE or E-stop.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.",
    "DebounceTime is a strictly positive constant throughout each test case. Dynamic changes are outside this benchmark domain. Time must advance for eventual-start properties.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values."
  ],
  "ltl": [
    {
      "id": "PUB005.P_init",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "init",
      "description": "Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.",
      "explanation": "Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "INITIAL_INSTANCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB005.P1",
      "formula": "G(Weld_Soft_Start_Active <-> startup)",
      "explanation": "Soft-start output means only the startup monitoring inhibition interval.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB005.P2",
      "formula": "G((startup | !Weld_E_Stop_NC | !Gap_Exceeded) -> !Operator_Alert)",
      "explanation": "Startup, E-stop or no gap forces the alarm off.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB005.P3",
      "formula": "G(Operator_Alert <-> (!startup & Weld_E_Stop_NC & Gap_Exceeded & gapQualified))",
      "explanation": "Alarm requires post-startup continuous qualified gap.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB005.P4",
      "formula": "G((startup | !Weld_E_Stop_NC | !Gap_Exceeded) -> X(!gapQualified))",
      "explanation": "Each suppressing condition clears or blocks gap qualification.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB005.P5",
      "formula": "(G(F(TimeTick))) -> (G((G(Weld_E_Stop_NC & Gap_Exceeded)) -> F(Operator_Alert)))",
      "explanation": "Persistent gap eventually alarms after startup and debounce, assuming advancing time. Explicit non-Zeno environment premise: physical elapsed time crosses infinitely many 1ms boundaries.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    }
  ],
  "atomic_propositions": {
    "startup": "Elapsed time since the first invocation is less than 5 seconds.",
    "gapQualified": "Gap_Exceeded has remained TRUE with Weld_E_Stop_NC TRUE and !startup for at least DebounceTime, measured from first eligible invocation.",
    "interface names": "Identically named sampled input or observed output.",
    "TimeTick": "Boolean: floor(t[k]/1ms)>floor(t[k-1]/1ms), with t[0]=0, TimeTick[0]=FALSE, t[k]=sum(dt_ms[1..k]). G(F(TimeTick)) states unbounded physical time progress; merely positive dt is insufficient.",
    "Gap_Exceeded": "I[k].Gap_Exceeded: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Weld_E_Stop_NC": "I[k].Weld_E_Stop_NC: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "DebounceTime": "I[k].DebounceTime: sampled input (TIME).",
    "Operator_Alert": "O[k].Operator_Alert: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "Weld_Soft_Start_Active": "O[k].Weld_Soft_Start_Active: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "init": "At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.Operator_Alert=false, O_init.Weld_Soft_Start_Active=true."
  }
}
Output budget: at most 2 cases, at most 8 steps per case. Use compact JSON. Cover a complete normal path and one important boundary. Keep reasoning concise enough to finish the entire JSON within the output budget.
